description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential full-time opportunity offers a chance to make a significant impact on patient care and facility success.
The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader with a passion for delivering high-quality healthcare services. You will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. This role offers a competitive salary and the chance to join a supportive team dedicated to excellence.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Strong leadership, financial management, and operational skills
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, commensurate with experience.

facilityType: A premier health and rehabilitation center
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Nurse (RN) to join our team as an MDS Coordinator in Missouri Valley, IA. This vital full-time role involves managing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) process, ensuring accurate assessments and comprehensive care planning for our residents.

As an MDS Coordinator, you will play a crucial role in maintaining regulatory compliance and optimizing resident outcomes. Your expertise will directly impact the quality of care provided, working collaboratively with our interdisciplinary team to develop and implement individualized care plans.

This is a permanent, full-time opportunity offering a competitive salary. We are looking for a committed professional to contribute to our mission of providing exceptional care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Proven experience as an MDS Coordinator, preferably with MDS 3.0.
Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to long-term care.
Excellent assessment, care planning, and communication skills.
This is a permanent, full-time position; interim candidates will not be considered.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $65,000 to $75,000 per year, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Venice, FL. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a recently purchased facility, contributing to a new chapter of growth and excellence in patient care. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in upholding high standards of clinical practice and operational efficiency.

As an ADON, you will support the Director of Nursing in overseeing all aspects of nursing care, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. This position offers a chance to make a significant impact within a supportive team, with competitive compensation for the right individual.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Florida.
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably in a skilled nursing facility.
Strong knowledge of state and federal long-term care regulations.
Demonstrated ability to supervise, mentor, and evaluate nursing staff.
Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is highly competitive and will be commensurate with experience and qualifications for the right candidate.
